**U.S. states that, as of December 31 , 2019, had:**

| State | No woman ever served as governor (elected or appointed) | No woman ever served in the U.S. Senate (elected or appointed) | No Electoral‑College vote cast for a woman presidential candidate |
|-------|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
| Colorado | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ |
| Indiana  | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ |
| Missouri | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ |
| Ohio     | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ |
| Pennsylvania | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ |

These states satisfy all three conditions simultaneously: they never had a woman governor, never had a woman U.S. senator, and, because no woman has ever been nominated as a presidential candidate before 2019, none of them ever cast an Electoral‑College vote for a woman at the top of a ticket.
